levels.title: Chimney
levels.text: Drag the REFLECTOR from the toolbox onto the board, and click it to turn it. A reflector is a mirror: it bounces the beam off at a right angle. Send the beam up the chimney to light the pinwheel.
levels.trick: one reflector turns the beam onto the target

levels.title: Spillway
levels.text: Walls stop light. The laser points straight at a wall, so use two REFLECTORS to carry the beam along the top and over the edge.
levels.trick: two reflectors route around a wall

levels.title: Street Lamp
levels.text: Light passes straight through a pinwheel and keeps going, so one beam can light several pinwheels in a row. Every pinwheel must be lit.
levels.trick: one beam passes through several targets

levels.title: Fishing Rod
levels.text: A BENDER is a slanted mirror. Turned one way it bends the beam by 45 degrees, from straight to diagonal or back; turned another way it throws the beam sharply back at 135 degrees. Cast the line from the tip of the rod.
levels.trick: bender: 45 degree turn, then a sharp 135 degree turn

levels.title: Standoff
levels.text: A pinwheel must be lit in its own colour and no other: a red beam spoils a green pinwheel. Turn each beam aside after its own pinwheel, before it reaches the other one.
levels.trick: colours must match; keep each beam off the other's target

levels.title: Big Top
levels.text: Now mix them. A reflector turns a diagonal beam by a right angle too. Raise the roof of the circus tent.
levels.trick: benders lift and lower the beam; a reflector on the diagonal makes the peak

levels.title: Walking Stick
levels.text: Drag a REFLECTOR from the toolbox onto the board, and click it to turn it. A reflector is a mirror: it bounces the beam off at a right angle. Bend the beam into a walking stick so that it lights every pinwheel.
levels.trick: routing with reflectors

levels.title: Arrow Slit
levels.text: Walls stop light dead. Find the one slit in the tower wall.
levels.trick: the straight line to the far side is walled off; the beam detours through the slit

levels.title: Ski Jump
levels.text: The BENDER is a mirror set at a slant. It turns a beam halfway round a corner: from straight to diagonal, or from diagonal to straight. Send the skier down the slope and off the jump.
levels.trick: routing with benders, diagonal to straight and back

levels.title: Bermuda Triangle
levels.text: Count the corners the red beam has to turn, then count your pieces: you are one short. And something must keep the green light out of the triangle.
levels.trick: red enters by the bender at the foot of the triangle, runs round all three sides and comes back into the same bender from above, which turns it a second time out through the corner; six turns from five pieces. The bender at the far corner also takes the green beam on its back
levels.motif: pictogram (a triangular room with a thick hypotenuse, a closet on the diagonal behind the foot, a green light on the far corner)

levels.title: Upstairs, Downstairs
levels.text: Two rooms upstairs with no door between them. Each laser can see its target through the wall, and the only way round is through the cellar.
levels.trick: one bender in the cellar's east corner turns both beams: green, which went down the middle stairwell, by 135 degrees back along the cellar floor and up the same stairwell on the other diagonal; red, coming down the east stairwell, by 45 degrees towards the west stairwell
levels.motif: rooms (a house in cross-section: two upstairs rooms, a floor with three stairwells, a cellar)

levels.title: Lockdown
levels.text: Eight sealed rooms. Every doorway in the block has been bricked up on the far side, so nobody can walk out. Light is not so polite about where it walks.
levels.trick: the walls only meet corner to corner across each bricked-up doorway, so a diagonal beam slips through: red crosses three rooms by the doorways, bouncing off a mirror standing in the first one; blue must not run on down the diagonal into red's target, so a mirror in its doorway turns it into the room next door
levels.motif: rooms (a block of eight rooms in brick bond, no doors, only gaps at the wall junctions, each with a wall straight behind it)

levels.title: Alchemy
levels.text: Light adds up. Where two beams meet on a target, it sees both colours together: red and green make yellow, red and blue make magenta, green and blue make cyan. Turn red and green into gold.
levels.trick: two beams crossing on one target mix their colours
levels.motif: two beams folded into a cross, mirror-symmetric about the diagonal

levels.title: Curtain Call
levels.text: WHITE light is red, green and blue together. A white target is only happy when all three reach it at once. Bring every stage light down on the star of the show.
levels.trick: three primaries meet on one target to make white
levels.motif: a lighting rig of three lasers whose beams fan down onto a stage

levels.title: Wrong Door
levels.text: A BLACK target wants darkness: if any light at all touches it, the level is not solved. Light passes through targets, so keep the beam well away from the dark one. Two doors lead through the wall; take the one nobody is guarding.
levels.trick: a black target rules out the short way; the beam takes the longer route
levels.motif: a wall with two doors, the near one guarded by a black target

levels.title: Carving Fork
levels.text: A SPLITTER is a half-silvered mirror: half the light goes straight through it and half bounces off at a right angle, so one beam becomes two. Hit it face-on and the bounced half goes straight back. Give the fork its second tine.
levels.trick: one beam split in two

levels.title: Chopsticks
levels.text: A SPLITTER lets half of a beam straight through and bounces the other half off at a right angle. It works backwards too: two beams that meet in a splitter mix, and the mixed colour leaves both ways. Red and green make yellow.
levels.trick: splitter merge: both outputs carry the mix

levels.title: Return to Sender
levels.text: What goes out must come back.
levels.trick: mirror back

levels.title: Crosshair
levels.text: Four arms, one beam.
levels.trick: mirror back + splitter

levels.title: Hurdle
levels.text: A BLACK pinwheel is lit by no colour at all, so no light may touch it, not even passing through. Clear the hurdle without knocking it.
levels.trick: black target: route the beam around it

levels.title: Slingshot
levels.text: One handle, two prongs, and only one beam to feed them both.
levels.trick: two-way splitter

levels.title: Roman Fort
levels.text: The fort has four gates and the two roads cross in the middle. Red marches in at one gate and blue at another.
levels.trick: a splitter where the roads cross splits both beams; every gate gets its own share, two of them in magenta

levels.title: Double Date
levels.text: Two colours, two targets, one meeting place.
levels.trick: splitter merge

levels.title: Bumblebee
levels.text: Yellow stripes, black stripes. Keep the black ones dark.
levels.trick: splitter merge

levels.title: Trading Places
levels.text: Four rooms and two cannons. Each muzzle wants a colour its own laser does not have.
levels.trick: blue reaches the red muzzle by running backwards up red's own beam: one splitter in the south-west room, where the two beams cross at right angles, sends each colour back along the other's path into the other's barrel, and its straight-through blue turns down to the blue target
levels.motif: rooms (a floor plan: four rooms, four doors, two cannons in opposite corners)

levels.title: Sneeze Guard
levels.text: Customer and cashier stand at either end of a long counter, and what one breathes out must not reach the other. The green parcels still have to get to both of them through the hatches. You have the one screen in the shop, and the mirrors are spoken for.
levels.trick: a splitter edge-on stops a beam dead from both sides, so it is the screen between red and blue; on the same square, green coming through a hatch on the slant still splits, one branch back over the counter and round to the cashier, the other through the counter and round to the customer. A mirror as screen with the splitter elsewhere is one piece too many
levels.motif: pictogram (a long counter between two people, with hatches in both sides, the screen off-centre)

levels.title: Ricochet
levels.text: Sometimes the way forward is straight back.
levels.trick: a splitter hit head-on above the red-and-blue merge sends magenta back down through two splitters, to the target south of the first splitter and back along red's diagonal to its laser
levels.proof: not proved; no other solution found in 300 s

levels.title: Cactus
levels.text: Trace every prickly edge of the cactus, arm by arm, without touching it.
levels.trick: one beam walks the whole outline of a cactus, into each crook and out again

levels.title: Connect the Dots
levels.text: One beam. Every pinwheel.
levels.trick: shared beam

levels.title: Boomerang
levels.text: Throw it well and it comes back to your hand.
levels.trick: long chain, beam returns to its source

levels.title: Lightning Bolt
levels.text: Strike from the top and zig, zag, zig to the ground.
levels.trick: long chain

levels.title: Anchor
levels.text: Drop in on the right, climb over the top, and come down on the left.
levels.trick: one beam visits both crooks of an anchor, crossing over its stock between them

levels.title: Rigging
levels.text: Rig the ship from bow and stern. The red and blue stays are mirror images.
levels.trick: two mirror-image diagonal beams zigzag over the masts as stays, crossing each other at every magenta knot, and end against the masts

levels.title: Pegboard
levels.text: Light only runs in the gaps between the pegs. Four lasers spin a pinwheel round the board.
levels.trick: a 4x4 grid of pegs lets beams travel and turn only on the lines between pegs; four rotated three-turn routes interlock, and the mixed dots mark where neighbours cross

levels.title: Crossword
levels.text: Across, then down. Where words cross, letters mix.
levels.trick: reflector routes that cross; crossing squares take both colours

levels.title: Picket Fence
levels.text: Squeeze through the gaps, one picket at a time.
levels.trick: two slaloms in opposite directions; each gap can only be crossed sideways

levels.title: Candelabra
levels.text: Each flame lights the far side of the candelabra.
levels.trick: the side flames cross over the top into the opposite bays, and the centre flame comes all the way round to the foot

levels.title: Ringing Fork
levels.text: Strike the fork once and both prongs ring.
levels.trick: one beam struck into the fork is split once; each half runs up the inside of one prong and down its outside

levels.title: Ice Bucket Challenge
levels.text: Cold pours in, and it must carry on to the bucket downstairs. Trouble is, water that lands on the bottom stays on the bottom. And somebody left the hot tap running into the top bucket.
levels.trick: blue cannot drop straight onto the floor of the top bucket: it would stop there. It has to come in on a slant, slosh flat along the floor through the target, and leave by a sharp 135-degree turn over the rim, then go round by the drainpipe to the lower bucket. Red has to be turned off the same column before it spoils the water.
levels.motif: pictogram (a bucket on a shelf above a bucket on the ground, a drainpipe, a hot tap over the top bucket)

levels.title: Leaded Window
levels.text: A FILTER is coloured glass: light that crosses it leaves in the filter's colour only, and light with none of that colour is stopped. It works only for light passing straight through its two glass faces, so turn it to face the beam. Glaze the gap in the window.
levels.trick: a filter turns white into its own colour, and only across its glass faces
levels.motif: a diagonal wall with one gap, crossed by a diagonal beam

levels.title: Chameleon
levels.text: A MULTI-FILTER is glass with a different colour on each side: light keeps only red, green or blue depending on which side it enters by, and between them are corners where it passes unchanged. Find the one turn that colours both beams right.
levels.trick: one multi-filter gives two crossing beams two different colours
levels.motif: two white beams crossing, one level and one diagonal

levels.title: Set Square
levels.text: The light crosses its own path once. One filter, two angles.
levels.trick: multi-filter at a self-crossing: white passes on the diagonal axis, the return leg turns green

levels.title: Candy Cane
levels.text: Red all the way up, and a white stripe wound around it.
levels.trick: a splitter makes a red shaft and a cyan stripe; reflectors zigzag the cyan across the red so every other square adds up to white
levels.motif: a candy cane: a striped shaft of targets with a fixed hook

levels.title: Awning
levels.text: Keep the rain off the two dark stones. Coloured glass only lets light through its faces; from the edge it is a wall.
levels.trick: each filter does two jobs: it colours the level beam passing through its faces and stops the falling beam that hits its edge
levels.motif: two rain streaks stopped by an awning

levels.title: Signpost
levels.text: A splitter that faces the light sends some of it back the way it came. What comes back can be a different colour from what went out.
levels.trick: head-on splitter returns a filtered beam to the first splitter, which turns it down the other half of the post

levels.title: Rose-Tinted Glasses
levels.text: Everything looks rosier through these.
levels.trick: filter

levels.title: Junction
levels.text: Everyone gets a share, and the leftovers go in the bin.
levels.trick: two-way splitter

levels.title: Double Glazing
levels.text: There is no red glass and no green glass in the box. Two panes together can still do it.
levels.trick: stacked filters: yellow then cyan leaves green, yellow then magenta leaves red; with one yellow pane it must go before the split

levels.title: Letterbox
levels.text: Only one slot in the wall, and two letters to post. Sort them again on the other side.
levels.trick: merge red and blue in a splitter to squeeze both through one slot, then split the magenta and filter it back into red and blue

levels.title: Times Square
levels.text: Red down the street, blue up the avenue, and the Great White Way stays white. The city can only afford one gel.
levels.trick: one multi-filter at the one crossing where street, avenue and Broadway meet: it reddens the street, turns the avenue blue and lets the diagonal through untouched, so three white beams from two splitters pass through it at once
levels.motif: pictogram (a street grid of city blocks with Broadway cutting diagonally across every crossing)

levels.title: Layer Cake
levels.text: White icing, yellow sponge, red jam, yellow sponge. Nothing on the plate.
levels.trick: filter

levels.title: Changing Room
levels.text: Everyone walks the corridor in white, door to door. The benches across from the cubicles want colour, and nobody may change on a bench.
levels.trick: a filter and a head-on mirror go inside a cubicle, not on the way to a bench; the filtered light comes back through the door splitter onto the bench opposite, and on along the corridor to the earlier door, where it adds to that bench: red there plus green from further along makes yellow
levels.motif: rooms (a row of three cubicles along a corridor, a bench niche opposite each)

levels.title: Gas Lamp
levels.text: Light the lamp. Its flame burns white, and the glass shows it only at the corners.
levels.trick: the flame can only be seen through the lantern's corners; a yellow beam and a blue beam cross there to make white
levels.proof: not proved; no other solution found in 300 s

levels.title: Jellyfish
levels.text: A PRISM splits white light into red, green and blue, and sends each colour off in its own direction. Turn it until the jellyfish trails all three tentacles.
levels.trick: one prism fans white light into three primaries
levels.motif: jellyfish: a diagonal body and three trailing tentacles

levels.title: Folding Fan
levels.text: The prism opens the fan into three ribs. Only one rib should catch the light.
levels.trick: multi-filter picks a colour before the prism, so only one rib lights; black targets on the others

levels.title: Crow's Foot
levels.text: The PRISM splits white light into red, green and blue, and sends each colour off at its own angle. Hit it at a slant and give the crow three toes.
levels.trick: split

levels.title: Paper Lantern
levels.text: The light goes into the lantern white and comes out white. Inside, it takes the long way round.
levels.trick: prism forwards then backwards: split white, carry each colour round its own path, merge it again

levels.title: Unfurl
levels.text: White is three colours folded together.
levels.trick: split

levels.title: Harbour Light
levels.text: Red climbs the tower and blue comes in from the sea. One lamp sends both out to the west.
levels.trick: the prism in the lamp room is a mirror for red and a window for blue

levels.title: Toasting Fork
levels.text: Turn a prism to a different face and it keeps one colour back. Make a toasting fork with a red prong and a green one, and nothing between them.
levels.trick: split; a prism turned another way swallows blue

levels.title: Watermelon
levels.text: A slice with a green rind, red flesh and dark seeds.
levels.trick: split

levels.title: Swimming Pool
levels.text: Only blue is allowed in the pool. Swim a lap.
levels.trick: the prism in the gap is turned so that it lets only blue through; turned the usual way, its green would spill into the pool

levels.title: Sky Rockets
levels.text: Two rockets go up and burst into colour. Where does each one burst?
levels.trick: prism forwards: the coloured sparks pin where each prism sits and which way it turns

levels.title: Meeting Point
levels.text: Two colours, one door.
levels.trick: prism merge

levels.title: Rocket
levels.text: White light in through the window, three colours out of the engine.
levels.trick: a prism under the nozzle fans the white beam into three flames

levels.title: Furl
levels.text: Fold the flag back up.
levels.trick: prism merge

levels.title: White Light
levels.text: Prisms work in both directions.

levels.title: Snowman
levels.text: Build him out of red, green and blue. Then give him a hat.
levels.trick: prism merge

levels.title: Duty Free
levels.text: Everything that crosses the border pays a tariff. The buyer at the far gate ordered yellow, and the only thing you have to collect it with is a prism.
levels.trick: hit from behind, a prism swallows the blue and throws red and green to opposite sides of the beam instead of fanning them; turned the usual way its blue runs straight on to the yellow target. Red and green go round either side and meet at the gate
levels.motif: pictogram (two walls: a thick border with one gate, an outer wall with the buyer in its gate; theme: a tariff as a toll on a beam)

levels.title: Rose Window
levels.text: Yellow glass in the window, and not a yellow filter in sight.
levels.trick: one prism is lit by two white beams at once, from below and from the south-east; the red of one and the green of the other leave together as yellow, twice, and the prism swallows both blues
levels.proof: not proved; no other solution found in 300 s

levels.title: Crossbow
levels.text: Shoot two colours back at the prism and see where they land.
levels.trick: head-on splitters send two colours back through the prism, which returns them as one beam along the white path to the first splitter

levels.title: Proof of Work
levels.text: Gold does not turn corners, and all you have is the tool that breaks it apart. Every block must be finished before the next can begin. There are no shortcuts to the coin.
levels.trick: only prisms: a yellow beam can never be turned whole, so to change direction it must be split, its red turned (a prism turns red 90 degrees), and merged again where red and green meet. The first block does this the short way; in the second the wall stops red on the near side, so it has to go all the way round and come back
levels.motif: pictogram (a chain of two blocks, the coin below the last, a hood over each exit that fixes where each block must finish)

levels.title: Citation Needed
levels.text: The red answer has been right since you opened the board, and it comes straight from the obvious source. Very confident. Yellow has no answer yet. Check your sources.
levels.trick: the red target looks settled, but it is lit by the wrong source: the red laser is the only red that can reach the speech bubble, and the prism only gives a red that can reach the target, so the lit target must be broken and relit by the prism's red
levels.motif: pictogram (a speech bubble with a tail pointing at the claim; a diagonal slit only green can use; a cited source shut off below a wall)

levels.title: Janus
levels.text: A DOPPLER shifts the colour of light that passes through it from the side: one way it turns red to blue, the other way red to green. Two red beams meet head on; the same doppler shifts each of them differently.
levels.trick: one doppler hit from opposite sides shifts the two beams in opposite directions
levels.motif: two-faced head: two lasers facing each other on one upright line

levels.title: Seesaw
levels.text: A quantum TANGLER splits a beam into twins that fly off in opposite directions. When one twin passes through a DOPPLER, the other twin changes colour too, at the same moment, but the opposite way.
levels.trick: the doppler on one twin recolours the other twin from the matching distance on
levels.motif: seesaw: a post with a plank balanced on top

levels.title: Compass Needle
levels.text: The QUANTUM TANGLER sends a beam out both ways at once, and the two halves stay linked: when a doppler changes the colour of one, the other changes too, the opposite way. Paint the needle red at the north end and blue at the south.
levels.trick: entangled twin

levels.title: Kebab
levels.text: The DOPPLER turns red light green, green light blue and blue light red. Turn it round and it works backwards. Tomato, pepper, tomato.
levels.trick: doppler

levels.title: Odd Socks
levels.text: They went into the wash as a yellow pair. One came out pink, the other blue.
levels.trick: entangled twin on a mixed colour, timed by distance

levels.title: Tuning Fork
levels.text: Strike it once and both prongs ring, each in its own colour.
levels.trick: a tangler makes twin beams; one doppler on either prong recolours both, in opposite directions
levels.motif: a tuning fork: the laser is the handle, two prongs of targets

levels.title: Question Mark
levels.text: Yellow is red and green together. What does a doppler do to two colours at once?
levels.trick: doppler on a mixed colour shifts both primaries

levels.title: Grappling Hook
levels.text: When a linked beam goes through a second tangler, it forgets its old twin and makes a new pair with its new partner. Paint the ring red, then paint the flukes without touching the ring.
levels.trick: entangled twin; a second tangler breaks the link

levels.title: Both Ways
levels.text: A doppler cares which way you go through it.
levels.trick: doppler

levels.title: Scarecrow
levels.text: White light goes in at the bottom. Can you dress one hand from the other?
levels.trick: entangled white: filter one twin, then shift it

levels.title: Branch Line
levels.text: Twins of twins. Who still feels what happens to whom?
levels.trick: a second tangler starts a new pair and cuts the old link

levels.title: Heartbeat
levels.text: A flat line, then a beat. The trace changes colour with every stroke of the pen.
levels.trick: dopplers on diagonals: facing decides the shift, two one way and one back

levels.title: Harlequin
levels.text: Red to green to blue, and home again.
levels.trick: doppler

levels.title: Customs House
levels.text: The crystal in the gate lets some colours in and turns others away. Both lamps inside the house must burn.
levels.trick: the gate prism lets only blue (straight) and green (bent) in, and the red the laser carries is lost; a doppler turns the blue back into red, which runs back along the green ray (yellow) and bounces off the back of the gate crystal to the red lamp
levels.motif: a walled customs house with a crystal in its only gate; the laser outside aims straight at the gate as a decoy

levels.title: Right of Way
levels.text: Two lines, two level crossings. Each train changes colour on the way and has to stop before the signal at the end of its line.
levels.trick: a doppler passes light on one axis and swallows it on the other: on a crossing it recolours the through train and stops the other. Each train is stopped by the doppler that recolours the other
levels.motif: a rail plan: walled tracks with sidings; the black targets are the signals at the ends of the two lines

levels.title: Rainbow Bridge
levels.text: Every colour has its own way across.
levels.trick: split

levels.title: Traffic Light
levels.text: Stop. Wait. Go.
levels.trick: splitter merge
levels.proof: not proved under the unified rules; no other solution found in 1200 s

levels.title: Bouquet
levels.text: Gather the three stems, tie them with a white ribbon, and let the flowers open again above it.
levels.trick: prism backwards then forwards: merge three colours into white, then split the white again

levels.title: Pennant
levels.text: Fly the pennant from the top of the pole, and make the pole above it white. The prism keeps only what it can use; nothing may spill out behind it.
levels.trick: prism backwards: three white beams enter from three sides; the prism keeps blue itself, but red and green must be filtered first or the leftovers spill south-west

levels.title: White Flag
levels.text: Red, green and blue give up their colours. Run the white flag up the pole.
levels.trick: a prism merges red, green and blue into white, which then outlines the flag

levels.title: Red Alone
levels.text: Yellow, from nothing but red.
levels.trick: doppler + prism merge

levels.title: Musical Chairs
levels.text: Red and blue trade seats; green keeps its own.
levels.trick: doppler + prism merge (split given)

levels.title: Secondary School
levels.text: Take white apart. Put some of it back together.
levels.trick: splitter merge

levels.title: Gap in the Rainbow
levels.text: Not every colour is welcome.
levels.trick: filter

levels.title: 3D Glasses
levels.text: One eye sees red, the other cyan. Put them back together.
levels.trick: filter + splitter merge

levels.title: Horseshoe Magnet
levels.text: One end red, the other end blue. Shift the colour round the bend, but not always the same way.
levels.trick: doppler facing: five dopplers, two shift one way and three the other

levels.title: Paint Palette
levels.text: Mix one yellow, then let the dopplers do the rest.
levels.trick: splitter merge + doppler

levels.title: Burgee
levels.text: No filter makes yellow. The two tails of this flag are yellow anyway.
levels.trick: split white, filter the halves red and green, then merge them in a splitter to make yellow

levels.title: Tinsel
levels.text: Drape the tinsel from the star down to the pot, a new colour on every branch of the tree.
levels.trick: zigzag of reflectors, a doppler on each branch; which way a doppler faces picks the colour

levels.title: Birdbath
levels.text: Three jets fall into the basin, and one more stream must run on.
levels.trick: the prism sits on a blue beam, which passes straight through, while it splits a white beam arriving diagonally into the three jets
levels.proof: not proved; no other solution found in 300 s

levels.title: Paint Shop
levels.text: White holds every colour. Take away what you don't need.
levels.trick: filter

levels.title: Deepfake
levels.text: Two identical portraits in yellow, and not a drop of yellow paint on the board. Only one of them is what it seems to be.
levels.trick: the fixed prism under the right portrait only gives a single yellow beam if red arrives along the row and green from the south-east; the left portrait is the fake, lit only where those same red and green beams cross on their way there, so the forgery lies on the road to the original
levels.motif: pictogram (two identical portraits with slotted frames, a fixed prism as the camera, and a plate for the blue left over)
levels.proof: not proved; no other solution found in 300 s

levels.title: Drainpipe
levels.text: A CONDUIT is a pipe: light passes through it only along its length, and you can't put a piece on it. Run the light along the gutter, down the pipe and out of the spout.
levels.trick: conduits carry light only along their axis and leave just the corners for the reflectors

levels.title: Swiss Cheese
levels.text: The whole board is a slab of cheese made of OCCUPIED squares: light crosses them freely, but no piece can be placed on them. Only the dark holes are free for your reflectors.
levels.trick: an occupied field leaves a handful of holes; pick the two that carry the beam to both targets
levels.motif: slab of cheese full of holes

levels.title: Venetian Blinds
levels.text: The slats only let light through on the slant.
levels.trick: conduit

levels.title: Tributary
levels.text: Where the stream meets the river, the water mixes.
levels.trick: a splitter where two beams cross at right angles merges them: both ways out carry the mix
levels.motif: a river with a tributary, drawn as beds of occupied squares

levels.title: Five Spot
levels.text: A die showing five. The spots are the only places on it you can use.
levels.trick: an occupied die leaves only its five spots free; red crosses the face corner to corner, blue runs along its foot
levels.motif: die face: 5x5 block of occupied squares with five free spots

levels.title: Ring Road
levels.text: The conduits only go one way. The corners go any way.
levels.trick: conduit

levels.title: Slalom
levels.text: Red skis down through every gate. The blue ski lift shows where to turn.
levels.trick: conduit gates fix the columns, crossings with the lift line fix the turns

levels.title: Loopholes
levels.text: Three archers, three loopholes, one white arrow.
levels.trick: the prism fans white into three angles; the loopholes are conduits that pass only one slant, so the prism must sit where the green ray already fits and the blue and red rays are bent into theirs
levels.motif: a castle wall of walls with three slanted loopholes (diagonal conduits)

levels.title: Three Sides
levels.text: Every line has a colour of its own.
levels.trick: split, beams sharing targets on an occupied field
levels.motif: open field of occupied squares with a few free stones

levels.title: Saloon Doors
levels.text: The doors swing both ways. Go out through one, come back in through the other, and meet up at the bar.
levels.trick: a fixed splitter halves one red beam; one half goes north through a doppler door and turns green, the other goes round the wall and comes south through the other door and turns blue; the fixed splitter at the bar mixes them to cyan
levels.motif: a wall of conduits with a pair of saloon doors (dopplers) in the middle

levels.title: Figure Eight
levels.text: A skater crosses her own tracks, and the ice remembers both colours.
levels.trick: the beam crosses its own path at the middle of an eight; a doppler on one loop makes the two passes differ, so the crossing mixes both
levels.motif: a figure eight skated round two patches of ice (occupied squares)

levels.title: Colour Wheel
levels.text: Six colours from a beam that carries two.
levels.trick: a yellow laser has no blue: a doppler makes it, and the beam crosses its own past

levels.title: Mixer Tap
levels.text: Hot from one pipe, cold from the other, and warm from the tap.
levels.trick: a splitter merges two beams into one

levels.title: Lollipop
levels.text: A red stick, and a swirl that changes flavour at every turn.
levels.trick: two dopplers on a square spiral; the beam climbs through one and falls through the other, so the same forward shift needs them turned opposite ways
levels.motif: a lollipop: a stick and a square swirl around an occupied centre

levels.title: Funnel
levels.text: Two colours in at the top, one colour out at the bottom.
levels.trick: a splitter merges two beams into the narrow spout

levels.title: Pipe Organ
levels.text: One red note, five pipes, and a different colour sounding in the middle.
levels.trick: splitters along one beam feed every pipe; dopplers between them shift the colour up and back down
levels.motif: an organ front: five conduit pipes, tallest in the middle, each crowned with a target

levels.title: Range Anxiety
levels.text: Home is an easy drive, but not on red. The car leaves nearly flat, there is one charger in town, and the junction sends each car by what is left in its battery, not by what the driver wants.
levels.trick: the fixed prism sorts by colour: red turns off down the charging lane and leaves green; green, brought back to the junction on the diagonal, turns down the same lane again and leaves blue; blue, on the same lap, goes straight through the junction and up the drive. One closed lap that stops itself when the car is full
levels.motif: town map: junction prism, charging lane (conduit with a fixed doppler), driveway (diagonal conduit), town blocks; the top-right corner is a no-parking zone

levels.title: Air Mail
levels.text: Red and blue, red and blue. Each change of colour needs a doppler the right way round.
levels.trick: alternating red and blue: each doppler shifts forward or back

levels.title: Bank Shot
levels.text: Nothing may rest on the felt, and every cushion is a mirror. A shot only gets onto the table down the slant of a pocket, then plays off the cushions. Find the two shots that colour all three balls.
levels.trick: a diagonal beam entering a square mirror table runs round an inscribed rectangle, so a target far from any opening is reached off the cushions; red's rectangle and blue's rectangle must cross exactly on the magenta ball, so the entry pockets are found by unfolding the bounces; a splitter and a doppler on the top rail give the two colours
levels.motif: pictogram: a pool table: reflector cushions, conduit pockets (each passes one slant), corner blocks, felt of occupied squares, balls as targets

levels.title: Geofence
levels.text: The fence around the no-fly zone looks complete, and nothing may land inside or near it. Two parcels are waiting in there. Drones are small.
levels.trick: the rounded fence leaves a diagonal seam at each corner; light slips between two walls that touch only at a corner. Yellow and cyan share green, so the prism must sit on the north-west seam's line; red and blue then have to swap sides, each going the long way round to the far corner and turning in with a bender, because blue leaves the prism eastward but must enter from the south-west
levels.motif: pictogram: a fenced no-fly zone (occupied squares inside and in a buffer around it), a few landing pads, open land to the south

levels.title: Barber's Pole
levels.text: Down through the base and back up again. Every stripe on the pole is painted twice.
levels.trick: entangled beam passes three dopplers out and back; its twin shows the palindrome

levels.title: Uncoupled
levels.text: Twins share everything, until they don't.
levels.trick: disentangle

levels.title: Bunting
levels.text: Two red lamps, three dopplers, and a line of flags in every colour but red.
levels.trick: two beams meet head-on through three dopplers; each doppler shifts them opposite ways

levels.title: Cat Flap
levels.text: The flap swings both ways, but the cat comes home a different colour.
levels.trick: a fixed doppler shifts red to blue going out and to green coming in; to come in green the beam must leave by another way
levels.motif: a door of conduits with a doppler flap at the bottom

levels.title: String Telephone
levels.text: Red talks, blue listens. Keep the line unbroken between them.
levels.trick: shared beam

levels.title: Tug of War
levels.text: Two teams pull on one rope. Which side of the knot are you on?
levels.trick: one doppler hit from both sides shifts each beam a different way

levels.title: Spooky Action
levels.text: Nothing can be placed in the conduits. Then again, nothing has to be.

levels.title: Picture Frame
levels.text: The twins set off round the frame in opposite directions. Every side gets painted by both of them.
levels.trick: entangled twins circle one loop both ways, so each doppler is passed twice, from opposite sides

levels.title: Stereoscope
levels.text: One white beam, two lenses: red on the left, cyan on the right.
levels.trick: a tangler sends white out both sides at once; a filter tints each lens
levels.motif: a pair of glasses: two lenses rimmed with occupied squares, the laser on the bridge

levels.title: Plumb Bob
levels.text: Drop the line down and it comes back up. Does it come back the same colour?
levels.trick: a head-on reflector returns the beam through the doppler, which shifts it back; the splitter sends the echo out the other side

levels.title: Ferris Wheel
levels.text: Red on the way up, blue at the top, red again by the time you get off. If the colours don't come round right, the whole wheel blurs to white.
levels.trick: a fixed splitter feeds the beam round a loop and back into itself; two dopplers on the loop must undo each other, or every lap shifts again and the loop goes white
levels.motif: a ferris wheel: a square wheel with a spoke up the middle, on an A-frame stand of occupied squares

levels.title: In Step
levels.text: Far apart, but never out of step.
levels.trick: entangled twin

levels.title: Yo-Yo
levels.text: Down it goes, and back to your hand the same colour it left.
levels.trick: doppler

levels.title: Flow and Return
levels.text: One red boiler, one valve, one pipe. Each window in the pipe wants a colour the boiler cannot make, and nothing can be fitted inside the pipe.
levels.trick: the doppler valve shifts red to blue for light flowing east and to green for light flowing west; a splitter at the west end sends red into the pipe from both ends at once, so the west window sees red and green (yellow) and the east window blue and red (magenta)
levels.motif: plumbing: a long conduit pipe with a doppler valve and two windows, a riser pipe down to the floor beside the boiler; the boiler aims straight at the valve, which only absorbs it

levels.title: Breakthrough
levels.text: Two crews dig from opposite sides of the mountain and meet under the summit. There is nothing in the toolbox to mix light with, and neither crew sets out in a colour the other side's lamp wants.
levels.trick: the fixed doppler in the tunnel turns red going east and green going west into the same blue, so each laser must fly over the mountain to the far portal and enter from there; with no splitter, the only way to mix is for the two beams to run head-on along one shared road from laser to laser, each picking up the other's blue
levels.motif: pictogram: a mountain of walls with a conduit tunnel through it, a doppler at the meeting point, a lamp on the summit, lasers on the valley floor

levels.title: Spin Cycle
levels.text: Red goes in. Whites come out.
levels.trick: a splitter feeds the beam into a loop and back into itself; a doppler on the loop shifts it each lap, so three laps make white
levels.motif: a washing machine: a square drum of white targets around an occupied load

levels.title: Wormhole
levels.text: The purple rings are TELEPORTERS. Light entering one comes out of the next one straight ahead, still going the same way, skipping anything in between, even a wall.
levels.trick: a fixed teleporter pair carries the beam through a wall; it carries on after the jump
levels.motif: a wall with a wormhole through it

levels.title: Bank Vault
levels.text: Light that enters a TELEPORTER jumps ahead to the next teleporter in the direction it is travelling, and carries on from there. Get the light into the vault without breaking a wall.
levels.trick: a fixed teleporter pair jumps the beam through the vault wall; only light travelling the right way finds the inside one
levels.motif: walled vault with the gold inside

levels.title: Hopscotch
levels.text: Hop over the dark squares. Where you start decides where you land.
levels.trick: teleport chain, entry parity

levels.title: Under the Alps
levels.text: A MOBILE TELEPORTER is a teleporter you place yourself. Light entering one jumps ahead to the next teleporter in its direction of travel, so two of them make a tunnel through anything in between, in any direction.
levels.trick: two mobile teleporters, one on each side of the mountain, form a tunnel
levels.motif: snowy mountain with a railway tunnel through it

levels.title: Puddle Jumper
levels.text: Don't get your feet wet.
levels.trick: mobile teleporter basics: a pair of teleporters carries a beam over squares it must not touch
levels.motif: a puddle of black targets across the only road to the goal

levels.title: Leapfrog
levels.text: Hop over some squares and land on others. Count before you jump.
levels.trick: mobile teleporter pairs jump the beam over chosen dopplers; skipping one backward doppler does what skipping two forward ones would, with a hop to spare
levels.motif: a hopscotch court: a column of fixed dopplers with pads between them

levels.title: Tunnel
levels.text: One tunnel through the mountain, and traffic in both directions.
levels.trick: teleport, two beams share one route in opposite directions

levels.title: Snakes and Ladders
levels.text: Climb the ladders to reach the top. Mind the snakes.
levels.trick: fixed teleporter ladders lift the beam; snake heads swallow any beam that strays onto them
levels.motif: snakes and ladders: vertical ladders and diagonal snakes of conduits between teleporters

levels.title: Hare and Tortoise
levels.text: Two runners leave together. One of them knows a shortcut.
levels.trick: entangled twin, timing through a teleporter

levels.title: Return Ticket
levels.text: White on the way out, blue on the way home. The tunnels let nothing touch the light.
levels.trick: recolour at the far end of two teleporter tunnels

levels.title: Smuggler
levels.text: Customs takes its cut of everything that crosses the border. Almost everything.
levels.trick: a pair of mobile teleporters carries white over a fence of red filters while its split twin pays the toll
levels.motif: a border: a full row of fixed red filters across the board

levels.title: Ship in a Bottle
levels.text: Some things are built from the inside.
levels.trick: mobile teleport

levels.title: Skyscraper
levels.text: The lift only stops where you get out. A splitter lets the light step off at a floor and ride on up at the same time.
levels.trick: teleporter lift; splitters in the lift's gaps serve two floors and keep the beam rising; dopplers colour each floor

levels.title: Hedgerows
levels.text: Three fields and two hedges. Don't disturb the cow in the middle field on your first trip.
levels.trick: one teleporter pair jumps both hedges at once, clearing the middle field; a second pair drops into it
levels.motif: three fields side by side, split by two hedgerows

levels.title: Compass Room
levels.text: The room has no door. Or rather, it has four.
levels.trick: teleport

levels.title: Passing Place
levels.text: A single-track road with two drivers nose to nose, and each one's turning is on the far side of the other. Nobody is reversing.
levels.trick: three teleporters on one line: the middle one is the far end of both tunnels, red going east and blue going west; each beam dies at the outer one the other enters by
levels.motif: a single-track road (one walled lane) between two lasers, one turning off to the north and one to the south

levels.title: Corked
levels.text: A red wine, and not a drop of blue in it. The cellar has run out of corks, so you will have to improvise.
levels.trick: a lone teleporter swallows any beam with no partner ahead: the cork in the neck stops blue, and on its diagonal it is also the far end of red's tunnel into the bottle
levels.motif: pictogram: a bottle with a three-wide neck, half full, in a wine rack

levels.title: Airlock
levels.text: Two hatches to each chamber, and no way to walk between them. Whatever gets in has to find its own way out.
levels.trick: a beam can go back into the teleporter it just came out of: travelling a new way it finds a new partner
levels.motif: rooms: a flight of two sealed chambers, each with an outer hatch on two sides

levels.title: 3-SAT
levels.text: (x1 ∨ x2 ∨ x3) ∧ (x1 ∨ x2 ∨ ¬x3) ∧ (x1 ∨ ¬x2 ∨ x3) ∧ (¬x1 ∨ x2 ∨ ¬x3) ∧ (¬x1 ∨ ¬x2 ∨ x3) ∧ (¬x1 ∨ x2 ∨ x3) ∧ (¬x1 ∨ ¬x2 ∨ ¬x3). Checking an answer is the easy part.
levels.trick: each reflector picks a truth value: the same laser can run down a literal's wire or its negation's, never both. Seven clauses of the eight on three variables leave one assignment
levels.motif: the cube: eight clause corners in two squares, rows for x1, columns joined by bridges for x2, a V and an inverted V for x3, with one corner missing

levels.title: Joust
levels.text: Two knights charge down the lists. Only one of them gets past the other.
levels.trick: a red filter passes red from yellow but stops cyan dead, so one side of it stays yellow and the other side mixes to white
levels.motif: a joust: the tilt barrier is a row of conduits, the knights ride in from opposite corners

levels.title: Running Stitch
levels.text: Two threads, one cloth. In and out, in and out.
levels.trick: two beams weave through the holes in a wall, their loops crossing on both sides

levels.title: Subset Sum
levels.text: S = {2, 5, 6, 9}, T = 13. Pseudo-polynomial, if that helps.
levels.trick: each column holds one detour, a pair of free squares exactly one element apart, and a detour exists for every sum reachable so far, each element's detours standing together in the order of S. Two reflectors take a detour; only one choice of detours lands on the target's row, and the largest-first choice overshoots
levels.motif: the dynamic programming table of the instance: the beam starts at sum 0 top left, one group of equal bars per element, the rows are the sums, and the target sits on row T

levels.title: Border Crossing
levels.text: One gate in the wall and two tunnels under it. Someone also has to patrol the wall.
levels.trick: teleporter tunnels under a conduit wall; a beam can run along the wall but not across it
levels.motif: wall with a gate and tunnels

levels.title: Envelope
levels.text: The flap is stuck down tight, unless you come at the seams on the slant.
levels.trick: a diagonal wall stops straight beams but a beam crossing it at right angles slips between the bricks; straight beams need a teleporter
levels.motif: back of an envelope: a V-shaped flap of walls across the top

levels.title: Zebra Crossing
levels.text: People on foot walk straight over the stripes. The traffic has to find another way across.
levels.trick: vertical conduit stripes stop a sideways beam; a teleporter pair carries it over the whole crossing at once
levels.motif: zebra crossing: five stripes of conduits across a road

levels.title: Switch Tracks
levels.text: The train and the car are each on the wrong road. Swap them, and let them meet at the crossing.
levels.trick: each laser starts on the other track; detour around the conduits

levels.title: Spaghetti Junction
levels.text: A side road meets the motorway, and three cars need to get across. You only have four flyover ends.
levels.trick: a square of four teleporters makes three flyovers: two corners are each shared by two beams travelling different ways, so four ends carry three crossings
levels.motif: a motorway T-junction: a side road of conduits running into the motorway, the four teleporters at the corners of a square straddling both

levels.title: Hamiltonian Path
levels.text: V = {a, b, c, d, e, f, g}, top to bottom. E = {ab, ac, ad, ag, bc, bd, be, bf, cd, df}. No return ticket required.
levels.trick: an arc diagram: each arc is one edge, a lane leaving one vertex row and joining another, and needs two reflectors. A beam crosses a vertex straight on, so it arrives on one side and leaves on the other; the toolbox holds exactly enough for a path through all seven vertices
levels.motif: arc diagram: the vertices in a line down the middle, every edge a clear lane on one side, lanes crossing on occupied squares

levels.title: Courtyard
levels.text: Four gates in, four gates out. Everyone crosses the courtyard.
levels.trick: four rotated routes enter and leave a walled courtyard, crossing inside

levels.title: Four Sails
levels.text: Catch the wind in every sail.
levels.trick: four rotated routes; each ends in a sail, and they cross around the hub

levels.title: Crossing Point
levels.text: Four travellers, one door, and nobody stops.
levels.trick: mobile teleport hub

levels.title: Circuit Board
levels.text: Light only runs along a trace, never across one. Follow the wiring, and drill a via wherever two traces meet.
levels.trick: conduit traces carry each colour from pad to pad; red and blue traces cut across each other, so each beam needs a teleporter pair as a via to hop the other's trace
levels.motif: a circuit board: conduit traces with gaps for pads, a red LED and a blue LED at the ends of their traces

levels.title: Hard a-Port
levels.text: The TWISTER is fixed to the board. Every beam that leaves it has turned 90 degrees to the LEFT of the way it was going.
levels.trick: twister basics: to leave eastwards the beam must come down into the twister from above

levels.title: Shepherd's Crook
levels.text: The knot at the top of the crook only ever turns left. Come at it from the right side.
levels.trick: a twister turns the beam left, whichever way it comes in; enter it from below to bend the hook over to the staff

levels.title: Turnstile
levels.text: A splitter facing you is not a wall.
levels.trick: head-on splitter

levels.title: Loop the Loop
levels.text: A filter seen from the side lets everything through. Seen from the front, it doesn't.
levels.trick: multi-filter passes white one way and filters the crossing beam

levels.title: Humbug
levels.text: The wrapper is twisted at both ends, and a twist only turns left. Red wraps the top, blue the bottom.
levels.trick: a twist at each end of the wrapper turns each beam left, so red has to go round the top and blue round the bottom

levels.title: Compass Rose
levels.text: Four roads meet at one filter. Each road leaves with its own colour.
levels.trick: one multi-filter colours four crossing beams

levels.title: Roundabout
levels.text: Traffic only ever turns left here.
levels.trick: twister

levels.title: Bowtie
levels.text: The knot in the middle turns everything left. Tie it so one wing comes out red.
levels.trick: diagonal beams through a twister

levels.title: Watch Spring
levels.text: Wind the spring inwards. It only ever turns left, and somewhere along the way it turns red.
levels.trick: an inward spiral of left turns; two fixed twisters show the way round, one multi-filter changes the colour partway

levels.title: Trident
levels.text: Three prongs from one shaft, and the hub only turns left. A splitter that faces the light sends some of it back.
levels.trick: head-on splitters feed a twister from new sides

levels.title: Scales
levels.text: The pivot turns every beam to its left. Red goes up, blue goes down.
levels.trick: the fulcrum twister turns the left pan's beam up and the right pan's beam down

levels.title: Battlements
levels.text: Every gap in the wall turns the beam left. Walk the wall the right way, and each tower gets its own flag.
levels.trick: twisters at the foot of every gap turn the beam only left, so the wall has to be walked from left to right; the beam must first go the long way round to the far tower

levels.title: Black Box
levels.text: White goes in and white comes out, as if the box weren't there. But something inside it has to show blue, and something has to show red. Take the light apart if you must; just put it back.
levels.trick: a prism breaks the white beam inside the box; twisters only turn left, and exactly that brings the fan back together: green takes one twister and red two to converge on a second prism, which merges all three into white on the original line
levels.motif: pictogram (a sealed box with an input and an output pipe)

levels.title: Tower Crane
levels.text: The top of the mast turns everything left. Send green up the mast and see where it ends up.
levels.trick: twister at the top of the mast: green climbing the mast is turned onto the counterweight arm and runs back down blue's path

levels.title: Tricolour
levels.text: Run the flag up the pole. Each stripe needs its own angle.
levels.trick: multi-filter angles

levels.title: Windmill
levels.text: The sails only turn one way.
levels.trick: twister + mirror back, C2 splitter, multi-filter, doppler

levels.title: Espalier
levels.text: A fruit tree trained flat against a wall. The trunk feeds the branches one after another, never two at once, and whatever a branch does to the sap, the next branch inherits.
levels.trick: a twister is not reversible: a beam sent back along a branch does not retrace, it takes the twister's next arm. So head-on mirrors at the branch tips walk the tree clockwise, each branch fed by the one before; a filter on a branch colours all later ones, and a doppler on the trunk shifts the light both ways, so the lowest right branch gets a colour that is on no other branch
levels.motif: pictogram (espalier tree: trunk and two tiers of branches, open lanes in a wall field)

levels.title: Carousel
levels.text: Round and round, and a little different every time.
levels.trick: twister loop + doppler cycle, multi-filter, C2 splitter mirror back

levels.title: Yin and Yang
levels.text: A QUAD BENDER is a bender with mirrors on both faces, so it turns a beam from either side. Meet red and blue in the middle and send them off to opposite corners.
levels.trick: quad bender basics: one piece bends two opposite beams, one on each face

levels.title: Three Hinges
levels.text: Each wing folds back on its own hinge.
levels.trick: quad bender reused, three times

levels.title: Silvered Both Sides
levels.text: A DUAL REFLECTOR is a mirror with silver on both faces: it turns a beam on either side. Put one where two beams cross and it can turn them both.
levels.trick: dual reflector basics: one mirror turns two beams, one on each face

levels.title: Kissing Gate
levels.text: Red and blue both come to the gate, and neither gets through. One mirror sends both away.
levels.trick: red and blue bounce off opposite faces of one dual reflector standing in the only gap of the fence

levels.title: Both Sides Now
levels.text: Most corners only turn one way.
levels.trick: quad bender vs bender

levels.title: Butterfly
levels.text: Each colour flies once round its own wing and passes through the body twice.
levels.trick: both beams use the quad bender at the knot twice; each wing is a triangle of 135-degree turns

levels.title: Full Circle
levels.text: What goes around comes around.
levels.trick: dual reflector hit twice, from opposite sides (loop; a prism fixes the direction)

levels.title: Bookshelves
levels.text: One goes down, one goes up. On every shelf they meet halfway.
levels.trick: dual reflectors: on each shelf the falling and the rising beam turn on the same square

levels.title: Hourglass
levels.text: Sand runs down, light runs both ways.
levels.trick: dual reflector: two beams share one square, one on each face

levels.title: Up Periscope
levels.text: Red looks through the periscope. The others only see the backs of its mirrors.
levels.trick: two dual reflectors in a periscope; each turns one beam on its front and another on its back

levels.title: Two-Faced
levels.text: Every coin has two sides.
levels.trick: dual reflector, one beam on each face

levels.title: Robot
levels.text: Red tickles the robot under one arm, blue under the other. Both go for its heart.
levels.trick: red and blue tour a robot and meet at the dual reflector in its chest, one on each face

levels.title: Semi-Detached
levels.text: Two houses, one wall between them. The neighbours share.
levels.trick: dual reflectors: each one turns its own house beam and the visitor from next door

levels.title: Mirror Image
levels.text: They meet three times and never cross.
levels.trick: three dual reflectors, each shared by both beams on opposite faces

levels.title: Loom
levels.text: Seven threads go into the loom. None is cut and none changes colour, and they still leave in a different order. A thread never turns on its own.
levels.trick: a dual reflector at a crossing turns both beams at once, one on each face, so each carries on along the other's line: a swap. The exit colours are a permutation, and the solution is a twill: a staircase of swaps
levels.motif: pictogram (a loom: warp and weft lanes in a wall field)

levels.title: Tariff
levels.text: White goods come down the fenced road, and each border takes its cut. But the customs sheds stand off the road, and the goods must be seen there still untaxed. Wherever the road is left, it carries on from that same spot.
levels.trick: a quad bender on the road turns the beam off it on one face; after a loop through the shed, where a filter takes the duty, the beam comes back on the other face and leaves along the road again, as if the piece were not there. A filter on the road itself lights the exit but can never show the untaxed goods
levels.motif: pictogram (a road between two fences with a gate every other square, a customs yard each side)
levels.proof: not proved; no other solution found in 300 s

levels.title: Glancing Blow
levels.text: Two knights charge down the lists and neither will give way. Each one's lady sits in the stand at the far end, behind his opponent, and no knight rides past the other.
levels.trick: two beams head-on down one lane, and each one's gate lies past the other's: plain pieces can't do it, since whichever turns first stops the other short of its gate. One quad bender where they meet glances both off at 45 degrees, red forward through a gate to the east of it, blue through one to the west
levels.motif: jousting lists: a fenced lane between two stands of seats (occupied squares) with aisles; each target sits just inside a decoy gate at the far end

levels.title: Morse Code
levels.text: Dot, dash, dot. The light ducks out of sight between the teleporters, and changes colour only where you can see it.
levels.trick: teleporter pairs hide stretches of the beam; dopplers can only work on the visible dashes

levels.title: Rail Network
levels.text: Three lines leave the central station. Where two lines meet there is a change of colour; where they don't, one goes underground.
levels.trick: prism split into three routed lines; a teleporter tunnel lets one line cross another without mixing

levels.title: Request Stop
levels.text: The express does not stop here. Unless asked.
levels.trick: mobile teleport, ordering on a line

levels.title: Reunion
levels.text: What one prism parts, another can join.
levels.trick: split and prism merge

levels.title: Shoelaces
levels.text: Red teeth on the left, blue teeth on the right. Every mirror in the middle is shared.
levels.trick: red and blue interlock down a column of dual reflectors, each using the face the other leaves free

levels.title: Twin Islands
levels.text: Two islands, one rule of the road, and every lamp its own colour.
levels.trick: multi-filter + twister

levels.title: Through the Looking Glass
levels.text: Step through the glass, and everything on the other side happens backwards.
levels.trick: a teleporter pair carries the beam through a wall; on the far side it must retrace the mirror image of its route and come home to the laser's reflection
levels.motif: a looking glass: a full wall down the middle with a mirror-symmetric staircase either side

levels.title: Christmas Tree
levels.text: Red trims the left of the tree, blue the right. They cross at the very top to make the star.
levels.trick: two beams zigzag up the sides of a tree and cross on the two faces of one dual reflector at the top

levels.title: Paperclip
levels.text: Bend the wire round twice. Where it doubles back on itself, let it slip through.
levels.trick: teleport bridges, one row used both ways

levels.title: Grand Tour
levels.text: Four rooms, eight doors, and the colours tell you the order of the visit.
levels.trick: teleport + doppler

levels.title: Changing Sides
levels.text: Both beams start red. They part as different colours.
levels.trick: doppler

levels.title: Level Crossing
levels.text: Two railway lines cross. Get both trains off the tracks and over to the far side.
levels.trick: one bender at the crossing derails both beams; teleporter pairs hop them over the line
levels.motif: two conduit railway lines crossing in the middle

levels.title: Home Broadband
levels.text: Both of you are working from home today, and both your desks at the office want you logged in. There is one line out of the house.
levels.trick: only two teleporters and one line between the buildings, yet two colours to send: red and blue must be merged on a splitter into one magenta beam, sent down the single tunnel, and parted again by a prism at the far end
levels.motif: pictogram: a house with a pitched roof and an office block, sealed; a town of occupied squares between them

levels.title: Four Winds
levels.text: The STARBURST is fixed to the board. A beam that enters it leaves as four beams, each turned 45 degrees from it: come in on a slant and they go out straight to all four sides.
levels.trick: starburst basics: a diagonal beam into a starburst comes out as a plus sign
levels.motif: compass: four straight arms around the starburst

levels.title: Dandelion
levels.text: Blow straight up the stem and the seeds fly off at a slant.
levels.trick: starburst basics: a beam that hits a starburst head-on sends four rays out diagonally
levels.motif: a dandelion clock: an occupied stem under a starburst head, four seed targets around it

levels.title: Lighthouse
levels.text: A lighthouse shines out to sea, not just at the sky.
levels.trick: starburst bounce-back: a beam sent straight back makes it fire its other four ways
levels.motif: pictogram, tower of occupied squares under a starburst lamp

levels.title: Sunrise
levels.text: Only straight rays get past the horizon.
levels.trick: conduit horizon passes only vertical light; the sun must be struck at a slant to shine straight
levels.motif: horizon line of conduits with the sun on it

levels.title: Cross and Saltire
levels.text: Come at it straight and it answers askew.
levels.trick: starburst

levels.title: Vertex Cover
levels.text: E = {ab, af, ah, bd, ce, cf, ch, de, dg, eg, fg}, k = 4. The budget is final.
levels.trick: a triangular adjacency matrix: each column of the row is a vertex a-h, a starburst there fires down both diagonals, and a target sits where two vertices' diagonals cross. Four starbursts must touch every crossing
levels.motif: a half adjacency matrix hanging below a row of eight feeds, every other square occupied

levels.title: Whirligig
levels.text: Blow on it and every vane turns the same way.
levels.trick: four starburst rays each turned a quarter-step the same way round
levels.motif: whirligig (paper windmill) on a stick of occupied squares

levels.title: Relay
levels.text: Pass it on.
levels.trick: starburst chain

levels.title: Chandelier
levels.text: Red and blue must both reach the chandelier to make it glow magenta. They can't both come down the chain.
levels.trick: two beams that strike a starburst straight mix on all four diagonal rays; one mirror can't drop both lasers onto the chain, so one comes in from the side
levels.motif: a chandelier: a starburst hung from a rod, four magenta arms, two drops hanging from benders

levels.title: Jack-in-the-Box
levels.text: The lid is shut tight, but the corners are open. Get red and blue inside to spring the jack, then catch it as it springs out.
levels.trick: the conduit box can't be entered straight on, so teleporter pairs carry red and blue in; struck square-on by both, the starburst springs out magenta through the open corners, and a mirror outside each corner catches one ray
levels.motif: a jack-in-the-box: a small conduit box with open corners, the starburst jack inside, four magenta rays springing out of the corners

levels.title: Eclipse
levels.text: The red moon has to pass in front of the sun without touching it.
levels.trick: a teleporter pair carries red straight past a starburst without firing it
levels.motif: sun disk of occupied squares, rays to four blue targets

levels.title: Binary Star
levels.text: One white laser, two stars. Each shines one way on the square and another on the slant, and the far one has them the other way round.
levels.trick: a star fed square-on fires only diagonals, but one of its own diagonal rays sent back through a green filter by a head-on mirror makes it fire a green cross too. So the near star runs white on the slant and green on the square; its green east ray and a white diagonal ray (turned by a mirror that also carries the far star back) strike the far star, which comes out the other way round: white on the square, green on the slant
levels.motif: a binary star: two stars on one line, each drawn by the open rays around it in a field of occupied squares; a feed lane below

levels.title: White Heat
levels.text: One red laser and one doppler, and yet the ember in the grate must glow white. A fire has to be fed.
levels.trick: a starburst fed by its own ray: one diagonal ray is bent (bender, mirror) round the doppler and back into the star square-on, so each pass adds the next colour until all its diagonal rays run white from a single red laser; a cyan filter then cuts the chimney beam out of that white
levels.motif: a fire grate: a furnace in a wall of firebrick, occupied squares as bricks and open grid lines between them, an ember in the grate below, a chimney above with the cyan target

levels.title: Dowsing Rod
levels.text: A LOGIC GATE lights up only when two beams arrive at once, on the slant from both sides of its back. It sends out one beam straight ahead, in the colour the two beams have in common.
levels.trick: logic gate basics: yellow and cyan meet in the gate and only their shared green comes out
levels.motif: a forked dowsing rod: two handles, two slanted arms, one tip

levels.title: Desire Path
levels.text: Everyone keeps to the pavement until two of them meet at the corner. Then they cut across the lawn.
levels.trick: logic gate basics: two straight beams meeting at a right angle make one diagonal beam
levels.motif: a lawn with a worn diagonal path from one corner to the other; beams along two pavements

levels.title: Shake on It
levels.text: It takes two to open this door.
levels.trick: gate basics

levels.title: Photo Negative
levels.text: A COMPLEMENTOR lets a beam through but swaps its colour for the opposite one: blue comes out yellow, red comes out cyan. It works on straight beams or on slanted ones, depending on how you turn it.
levels.trick: complementor basics: blue becomes yellow, and the complementor must be turned to suit a diagonal beam
levels.proof: not proved: complementor rules are approximate in clingo; no other solution found

levels.title: Whole Again
levels.text: Every colour has another half.
levels.trick: complement
levels.proof: not proved: complementor rules are approximate in clingo; no other solution found

levels.title: Sweetheart
levels.text: Two halves make a whole heart, and only together are they red.
levels.trick: logic gate: magenta AND yellow gives the red no laser has
levels.motif: heart outline traced by two beams meeting at a gate

levels.title: Crown Jewels
levels.text: Each jewel is set where two bands of the crown meet, and it keeps only what they share.
levels.trick: three logic gates; splitters in the valleys feed one colour to two gates, so red, yellow, cyan and blue make red, green and blue jewels
levels.motif: a crown: a zigzag of beams with a gate and a jewel at each point

levels.title: Half Shares
levels.text: One yellow, two partners, two different answers.
levels.trick: gate fed by splitter

levels.title: Martini
levels.text: Strike the olive at a slant and it lights the rim of the glass. Where the rim pours down, the two streams must meet.
levels.trick: a starburst hit diagonally fires straight; its two side rays are bent down into a logic gate that pours the stem
levels.motif: a martini glass: rim, V-shaped bowl, olive on a stick, stem and foot of occupied squares

levels.title: Graph Coloring
levels.text: E = {ab, ad, bc, cd, ce, de, df, ef, eg, fg, fh, gh}, k = 3, b = G, g = R. The cartographers get four.
levels.trick: vertices a-h in a row, each turned one primary by a multi-filter's rotation; each edge is a fixed AND gate where two vertices' diagonals cross, so equal colours fire it into its black target. White fires too, and the multi-filter cannot go dark. The triangle strip cde, def, efg, fgh forces c = f, d = g and e = h, nothing follows locally from the two fixed vertices, then g = R gives d = R, so c = B through b = G, and a closes the 4-cycle abcd as B
levels.motif: a row of eight sockets with gates above and below where diagonals cross

levels.title: Common Ground
levels.text: Neither of them is blue, yet both of them are.
levels.trick: colour AND

levels.title: Fountain
levels.text: Two pipes feed one jet. The water only rises when both are running.
levels.trick: a logic gate joins cyan and magenta into a blue jet that sets off a starburst straight up, spraying diagonally into the basin
levels.motif: a fountain: occupied basin, a vertical jet, a starburst head spraying down to the rim

levels.title: Inside Out
levels.text: White has no opposite.
levels.trick: complement + prism split
levels.proof: not proved: complementor rules are approximate in clingo; no other solution found

levels.title: Wishbone
levels.text: Pull both ends and only what they share comes away.
levels.trick: logic gate: yellow AND cyan gives green; a splitter and two filters feed it from one white laser
levels.motif: a wishbone: two diagonal arms meeting at a gate, the stem below

levels.title: Detour
levels.text: The yellow beam is already on its way to the star. That is the problem.
levels.trick: yellow must be turned away from the starburst it is heading for and brought back diagonally (dual reflector, then quad bender), so the starburst fires straight; its west ray returns to the same dual reflector on the other face, cyan uses it too, and a logic gate takes yellow's straight ray and cyan's bent diagonal ray to make green
levels.proof: not proved; no other solution found in 280 s

levels.title: Trade War
levels.text: The border lets nothing across square-on, and at the customs gate only what both sides have in common gets through. Green is easy. How does yellow cross with nothing taken off it?
levels.trick: a diagonal wall stops straight beams but a slanting beam slips between its corners, and only a gate can turn a straight beam onto the slant. Yellow AND cyan pays the tariff and crosses as green; to cross whole, yellow must be split and gated with itself, because a beam ANDed with itself loses nothing
levels.motif: a border: a diagonal wall across the whole board, the home side a street grid of open squares between occupied blocks, the far side occupied land with one target in each slanting line of sight

levels.title: Short Circuit
levels.text: Red in, red out, and nothing past the machine. It cannot be unplugged, but no machine can bear to hear its own answer.
levels.trick: the fixed complementor must go dark while red still reaches it: send its cyan output right round the board and merge it back onto its own input with a splitter. Its input changes, it contradicts itself and shuts down, and the whole loop goes dark. A red filter that seems pointless protects the second complementor on the splitter arm, which the surge would also shut down
levels.motif: circuit board: a component on a trace (complementor between its red target and black target), two empty rooms joined by a door, a via down to the trace, and a lower room
levels.proof: not proved; no other solution found in 300 s

levels.title: Agent Loop
levels.text: Two agents, each sealed in with what it knows. Neither says anything it wasn't asked, and all you can ask about is red.
levels.trick: a gate's output may be fed back to its own input: yellow AND red answers red; red through a doppler is the green question that makes yellow answer in full and cyan answer at all. The ring grows
levels.motif: a data centre: racks of occupied squares with aisles, two sealed models each feeding a gate

levels.title: Wishing Well
levels.text: Drop a wish down the well. The echo comes back up and rings the bucket.
levels.trick: a splitter over the well shaft sends half the beam down; a mirror at the bottom sends it back up, and the splitter splits it again into the bucket

levels.title: Fishbone
levels.text: Every rib has two sides. The light only has one way in.
levels.trick: mirror back through splitters

levels.title: Ferry
levels.text: The river can't be crossed on foot, but the ferry runs both ways.
levels.trick: one teleporter pair carries red over the river and green back

levels.title: Plumbing
levels.text: Hot and cold must both run through the mixer pipe. Where the pipes cross, one has to go under.
levels.trick: red and blue enter the mixer pipe from opposite ends, so each flows back out through the other's pipes and the whole system runs magenta; a teleporter pair takes the hot pipe under the cold riser
levels.motif: plumbing: a cold riser, a hot supply, a mixer pipe with a tap in the middle and a gauge where hot crosses cold, joints left open for elbows

levels.title: Paper Fan
levels.text: Open the fan, then fold it shut again.
levels.trick: split + prism merge + mirror back

levels.title: Round Trip
levels.text: What goes out red comes back changed.
levels.trick: complement + filter, mirror back
levels.proof: not proved: complementor rules are approximate in clingo; no other solution found

levels.title: Hotel Corridor
levels.text: Four rooms, one door each onto the corridor, and the corridor leads nowhere. Both far rooms want both colours.
levels.trick: each splitter at a door sends one colour the wrong way along the corridor; a mirror at each dead end sends it straight back, so the light returns through the other splitter's door and both rooms get red and blue
levels.motif: rooms (a hotel corridor: four rooms, one door each)

levels.title: Echo Valley
levels.text: Shout across the valley and something comes back. Here, it comes back green.
levels.trick: a head-on splitter sends part of the beam straight back through the filter and the tunnel, so the far side's colour comes home
levels.motif: a ravine splits the board; a home side and a far side with one tunnel between

levels.title: Speaking Tube
levels.text: Shout into one pipe and listen. An old ship's voice pipe carries your words a long way, and what you hear back is not always quite what you said.
levels.trick: the yellow target is at the top of a pipe that opens only onto the white beam's own lane: red and green are sent straight back by two head-on reflectors, recombine in the prism, run home along the white beam, and a splitter on that lane taps the returning yellow off up the pipe
levels.motif: pictogram (a ship's voice pipes: a sealed pipe to the yellow target, a feed pipe up into a room, a hall below)

levels.title: Doubling Back
levels.text: Some light has to come home before it can go out.
levels.trick: red and green leave the prism by different sides, run round a reflector-bender triangle inside the house in opposite directions, re-enter the prism and leave together as one yellow beam that draws the roof; cyan is the prism's blue crossed by that yellow after a multi-filter
levels.motif: pictogram (a house: walls, floor and chimney; the solved yellow beam draws the roof)

levels.title: Viaduct
levels.text: Three piers hold up two arches, and each lamp post needs its own colour. Which laser belongs on which pier?
levels.trick: fixed gates at the tops of the arches are fed by starburst rays; the red and blue lamps decide that magenta goes to the middle pier, so the lasers cross over to reach their piers
levels.motif: a viaduct: three starburst piers on an occupied deck between two abutments, two arches with lamp posts above, the arch feet walled below the deck

levels.title: Change of Heart
levels.text: One straight beam lights white, then cyan. Nothing stands between them.
levels.trick: a tangler's twin changes colour in mid-flight: filter the other twin to red and shift it, close enough to the tangler, and the near twin loses red after it has passed the white target
levels.motif: open field; the laser points straight at the blue target as a decoy
levels.proof: not proved; no other solution found in 300 s

levels.title: Swing Door
levels.text: Red goes in. Yellow, magenta and cyan come out.
levels.trick: a splitter sends red round a loop both ways, so one doppler is passed from both sides: red going east turns blue, red coming back west turns green, and the loop feeds the splitter again
levels.motif: open field; three targets, the laser row carries two of them

levels.title: Jailbreak
levels.text: Two prisoners, two cells, one getaway car waiting outside.
levels.trick: teleporter pairs carry each laser out through its cell wall; the routes meet at one target
levels.motif: a prison block: two sealed cells side by side, a laser locked in each

levels.title: Backwash
levels.text: Not all light travels away from its laser.
levels.trick: blue joins the red beam at a splitter on a loop and flows back along red's whole path, through two reflectors, into the magenta target at the red laser's muzzle; the same loop turns the splitter's light south
levels.proof: not proved; no other solution found in 300 s

levels.title: Stopover
levels.text: A teleporter does not care where it was meant to send you. It sends you to the first one it finds.
levels.trick: a mobile teleporter dropped between a fixed pair catches the red jump halfway (so a quad bender can feed the starburst diagonally), and later throws blue back out of the far teleporter onto the red laser's own line
levels.proof: not proved; no other solution found in 300 s

levels.title: Thin Ice
levels.text: Nothing can be placed on the frozen pond, yet the skater crossing it must change colour twice before reaching the far bank.
levels.trick: the ice forbids a doppler on the crossing beam, so a tangler sends a twin the other way; a doppler on the twin recolours the skater at the same distance from the tangler, so the two dopplers must sit on the bank at the distances of the gaps between the holes (red to blue after the first hole, blue to green before the far bank)
levels.motif: a frozen pond of occupied squares with two fishing holes; the laser on the east bank, the twin walks the west bank
levels.proof: not proved; no other solution found in 300 s

levels.title: Skipping Rope
levels.text: Two children turn one rope from opposite ends. Each doppler is crossed both ways, and shifts the two colours apart.
levels.trick: two lasers share one route in opposite directions; each doppler shifts them opposite ways

levels.title: Scaffolding
levels.text: Blue climbs to the top of the scaffold. Red has to come down a different pole.
levels.trick: a twister where blue (going east) and red (climbing the right pole) cross turns both left at once: blue up to its target, red back west along blue's own board into the prism, which let blue straight through but sends the returning red down the left pole
levels.motif: pictogram (scaffolding: three poles, two boards, a diagonal brace and one clamp; open lanes in a wall field)

levels.title: Fireworks
levels.text: Four rockets go up from one fuse. Where the sparks cross, the colours mix.
levels.trick: splitters along the ground send up four white rockets; prisms burst each one into a fan, and the fans cross to make mixed colours
levels.motif: fireworks: four white trails rising from the bottom edge, each ending in a three-colour fan

levels.title: Raising the Colours
levels.text: Three colours, one filter, one flag.
levels.trick: three white copies (two splitters, a reflector and a 135-degree bender from the bottom) cross at one multi-filter; the one coming down leaves red, the one from the side blue, the diagonal one green; a reflector and a bender then lay red and green along the flag beside blue, so no target line points back at the junction
levels.motif: pictogram (a flag on a pole: the flag is occupied squares, the pole a wall; the laser line is the halyard to the pole top)
levels.proof: not proved; no other solution found in 300 s
